claims.title: P2 heritable photonic matter: synthetic models only

quoted_fields.interface: Common-bath allele-addressed PDI/6HB material is proposed. Author reports synthetic fresh-preparation selection models;physical expression and recovered functional heredity are not demonstrated.
quoted_fields.failure: Correlated occupancy,folding and genotype-by-batch variability can defeat reproducibility. Corrected all-input normalization is essential;ideal decoupled10-bit dimers give at most11spectra. No experimental evolution,practical advantage or breakthrough. N1673 is a distinct peptide handoff.
